identity: ONE original athletic soldier, the Chainford Marshal, facing screen right in elevated three-quarter view. Keep the adult man with wavy collar-length dark brown hair and a short full brown beard, the long weathered dark crimson military coat with split tails below the knee, engraved copper-bronze shoulder pauldrons, a cream neck scarf, crossed brown leather chest straps, a broad buckled belt with pouches, dark trousers, dark brown knee-high armoured boots with bronze kneecaps and dark leather gauntlets. Exactly two arms, two hands and two legs. Each hand holds ONE short bronze and dark steel baton ending in a curved hook; ONE heavy steel chain joins the two handle butts and hangs across the front of the body. Both hooks and the chain stay attached and keep their lengths. Preserve the weapons, the coat and adult proportions.
plate: Locked orthographic camera, fixed anatomical scale and centred body. Keep the full head, both hooks, the chain, limbs and boots within frame. The background is perfectly flat saturated BLUE throughout, no gradients or changes of hue. The blue background stays the same flat saturated blue in every frame and never darkens, flashes or changes colour. No scenery, floor shadow, camera motion, zoom, additional weapons, magic, glow, particles or extra limbs. Articulate joints naturally with physical planted-foot support; do not morph the equipment.

idle_h3_v1.action: A ready, watchful idle that loops. He breathes, the shoulders rise and fall, the head turns slightly and the far hand lifts its hooked baton a little so the chain swings, then everything returns smoothly to the original stance. Both boots stay planted; the coat tails stir gently. No walking and no attack.

move_h3_v1.action: Walk in place through two complete reciprocal cycles. Alternate near and far legs through forward contact, weight loading, passing and lift; both knees articulate and each boot alternates taking weight and swinging. The torso stays centred for engine-driven travel. Both hooked batons are held low at the sides with the chain hanging between them; the coat tails swing with the legs. Finish in the original gait phase.

attack_h3_v1.action: Make ONE fast hooking strike toward screen right. Raise the near hooked baton high over the shoulder as the knees load, then lunge forward on the front leg and lash the far hook out to full reach at screen right with the chain pulled taut between the hands, then draw back and settle into the original stance. One strike only; both batons stay in hand and stay joined by the chain.

hit_h3_v1.action: Start rocked back in a flinch, then recover completely. The head and shoulders snap backward and the knees flex while both hands keep hold of the batons, then he rebalances on both boots and returns to the same stance. Remain standing with all equipment held. Only the body moves; nothing else appears in the frame.

defend_h3_v1.action: Cross both hooked batons in front of the chest with the chain drawn tight, then sink into a wide low crouch behind the crossed hooks and hold the guard on both planted boots. No attack and no return to the relaxed stance.

cast_h3_v1.action: A rallying physical signal. Raise both hooked batons high above the head with the chain stretched taut between them, hold them up briefly, then lower them back to the original stance. A physical gesture only: no spell, glow or emitted effect.

death_h3_v1.action: Collapse continuously from standing: he doubles over, sinks onto his knees with the hooks dragging on the ground, then topples onto his side and lies stretched out motionless with the head at screen left and the boots at screen right, both hooked batons and the chain lying on the ground in front of him. No recovery, no floating equipment and no disappearing body.
